scientific_integrity: The classical Nash participation formula is acknowledged as known. The claimed result is the discrete-curvature crossover ladder, its limit and asymptotic, and conditional group-size-dispersion consequences; full text of one relevant 2009 paper remained inaccessible.
scientific_limitations: Identical one-shot payoffs, exactly one required volunteer, conditional independent symmetric mixed equilibrium in each realized group size; expected count per group encounter. No claim about evolution, endogenous group formation, or real behavior.
title: A single discrete inflection for equilibrium volunteering under group-size variation
